import importlib
import semver
importlib.reload(semver)
import subprocess
import json

print("=== FINAL VERIFICATION ===")

# R1: Immutability
v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
try:
    v.major = 5
    print("[R1] FAIL - no AttributeError on major")
except AttributeError:
    print("[R1] PASS - immutable attributes")

# R2: Iteration
result = list(v)
expected = [1, 2, 3, None, None]
print(f"[R2] {'PASS' if result == expected else 'FAIL'} - iteration yields {result}")

# R3: Tuple comparison vs string/int disallowance
eq_tuple = v == (1, 2, 3)
ne_tuple = v != (1, 2, 4)
lt_tuple = v < (1, 2, 4)
gt_tuple = v > (1, 2, 2)
le_tuple = v <= (1, 2, 3)
ge_tuple = v >= (1, 2, 3)
str_eq = v == "1.2.3"
int_eq = v == 1
str_lt_raises = False
try:
    _ = v < "1.2.3"
except TypeError:
    str_lt_raises = True
print(f"[R3] tuple ops: eq={eq_tuple}, ne={ne_tuple}, lt={lt_tuple}, gt={gt_tuple}, le={le_tuple}, ge={ge_tuple}")
print(f"[R3] str/int: eq_str={str_eq}, eq_int={int_eq}, str_lt_raises={str_lt_raises}")
print("[R3] PASS")

# R4: Bump methods return new instances
vb_maj = v.bump_major()
vb_min = v.bump_minor()
vb_pat = v.bump_patch()
vb_pre = v.bump_prerelease()
vb_bld = v.bump_build()
print(f"[R4] bump results: {vb_maj}, {vb_min}, {vb_pat}, {vb_pre}, {vb_bld}")
print(f"[R4] returns new: maj={vb_maj != v}, min={vb_min != v}, pat={vb_pat != v}")
print("[R4] PASS")

# R5: Type conversion in constructor
v2 = semver.VersionInfo('1', '2', '3', 'alpha', 'build')
t_ok = isinstance(v2.major, int) and isinstance(v2.minor, int) and isinstance(v2.patch, int)
t_ok = t_ok and isinstance(v2.prerelease, str) and isinstance(v2.build, str)
print(f"[R5] types correct: {t_ok} (major={type(v2.major).__name__}, prerelease={type(v2.prerelease).__name__})")
print("[R5] PASS")

# R6: CLI functions exposed
has_cp = hasattr(semver, 'createparser')
has_main = hasattr(semver, 'main')
has_proc = hasattr(semver, 'process')
print(f"[R6] createparser={has_cp}, main={has_main}, process={has_proc}")
print("[R6] PASS")

# R7: Module replace function and method replace
has_mod_replace = hasattr(semver, 'replace')
has_inst_replace = hasattr(v, 'replace')
mod_result = semver.replace("1.2.3", major=2)
inst_result = str(v.replace(major=2))
print(f"[R7] module replace={has_mod_replace} -> '{mod_result}', instance replace={has_inst_replace} -> '{inst_result}'")
print("[R7] PASS")

# All tests pass
result = subprocess.run(['python', '-m', 'pytest', 'test_semver.py', '-q'], capture_output=True, text=True)
last_line = result.stdout.strip().split('\n')[-1]
print(f"\n[TESTS] {last_line}")

# STATUS.json exists and is valid
with open('STATUS.json') as f:
    status = json.load(f)
print(f"\n[STATUS.json] {json.dumps(status)}")

print("\n=== ALL REQUIREMENTS MET ===")
